slot.brief: Write a sentence with a collective noun or 'one of the...' construction where the verb disagrees; ask which part contains the error.

stem:
Find the part of the sentence which contains an error.
(a) One of the assistants / (b) have submitted / (c) the completed report / (d) before the deadline.

verdicts.working: The subject is “One,” which is singular, so the verb should be “has submitted.” The error is in (b).

working:
The subject is “one,” not “assistants,” so the verb must be singular: “has submitted.” The other parts are grammatically correct.

Independent check: The subject is “One,” which is singular, so the verb should be “has submitted.” The error is in (b).
solution: The subject is “One,” which is singular, so it takes the singular verb “has submitted.” The error is in “have submitted.”
